rachats.citation: NOTES TO CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS (CONTINUED) OTHER IMMATERIAL ACQUISITIONS Kalil Acquisition On May 30, 2024, we entered into an agreement with Kalil, under which we agreed to acquire all of Kalil’s production, sales, and distribution assets for total consideration of $ 103 million, subject to certain adjustments outlined in the agreement.

_note: Rachats finalises depuis 2016 : balises XBRL des rapports annuels (allocation du prix d achat ou ecart d acquisition = rachat finalise) et Wikidata (entrees datees). Petites acquisitions non nommees par la societe absentes.
